title: Colaberry Case Study repository manifest
description: Optional `case-study.json` at the root of a repository. Every field is optional: a manifest is authoritative ONLY for the fields it declares, and only relative to deterministic repository inference (source-priority tier 5, spec §9). Declaring `publication.requested_surfaces` never grants publication, and declaring an entry under `outcomes` never verifies it — outcome metrics are recorded with verification_class `pending` until a human verifies them. Unknown properties are ACCEPTED but stripped, reported back to the admin, and never authoritative; that is why `additionalProperties` is true. Canonical prose: docs/case-study/case-study-schema.md. Enforcing implementation: backend/src/services/caseStudy/caseStudyManifestReader.ts.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. Only 1 exists. Anything else is rejected rather than guessed at.

slug.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier. A suggestion: the platform still owns slug allocation and collision handling.

capabilities.description: Capability facets, e.g. rag, document-ai, agents.

stack.description: Technologies. Repository inference also derives these; a declared list takes precedence over inference only.

type.description: Who did the work. Same vocabulary as CaseStudyBuiltByType in backend/src/types/caseStudy.ts.

publication.description: A REQUEST, never an authorisation. The reader returns `authorizesPublication: false` for every manifest without exception; only the publish gate can publish, and in Phase 1 only the `enterprise` surface is publishable at all.

consent.description: Consent signals from the repository author. They can only ever REMOVE permission relative to the platform record; they never grant naming rights that consent records do not already carry.

repos.description: Evidence repositories. Recorded, never fetched by the reader: no URL in a manifest is ever dereferenced.

url.description: An https:// URL or an owner/repo shorthand. http://, javascript:, file: and anything carrying whitespace or quoting characters are rejected.

outcomes.description: Claimed outcome metrics. Declaring one records a CLAIM, never a verified fact: the reader stamps verification_class `pending` on every entry regardless of what the file says, and a human must verify before any figure can be published.

value_display.description: Human-readable figure exactly as it should render, e.g. "40 → 12 min".

verification_method.description: WHO the author says established the figure. Orthogonal to verification_class, and it never promotes the class out of `pending`.

evidence_ref.description: Free-text pointer for a human verifier to follow. Never fetched.
